query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count!" FROM (
                SELECT 1
                FROM user_sign_ins s
                WHERE s.user_id = $1
                  AND (s.created_at >= NOW() - make_interval(days => $2)
                       OR s.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM user_sign_ins WHERE user_id = $1))
                GROUP BY s.ip, s.country_id, s.region_id, s.city_id
            ) grouped
